title: Speak Only That Which Will Bring You
summary: Speech is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating a rotting carcass; o Baba, speak only that which will bring you honor
lifeApplication: Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
